meta.title: Williams in Directive 8020 — CEO
meta.description: LaMarcus Williams — CEO. The CEO of Corinth, the company behind the mission.
meta.ogDescription: LaMarcus Williams — CEO. The CEO of Corinth, the company behind the mission.

blocks.text: LaMarcus Williams is Corinth’s billionaire CEO. He comes from a wealthy Californian family and wants to establish a legacy of his own. Stafford and Bill Young’s Mars mission helped inspire his ambitions. His presence links the expedition to the company behind it, without making a corporate title proof of any hidden allegiance.

The official introduction presents Williams as convinced that Earth cannot be saved and that Corinth’s mission offers humanity a future. These beliefs make him a divisive public figure. They are background information, not evidence for a guaranteed result from shooting him, standing down or choosing a particular ending.
